_about: The rules a muhurta search applies, as data rather than code, so that a rule can be read, argued with
and corrected without touching the arithmetic that applies it. Every field here is checked against the
panchang the engine computes; nothing in this file is interpreted loosely.
tithi numbers are 1-15 within the paksha. 4, 9 and 14 are the rikta ('empty') tithis that classical
texts set aside for beginnings; 15 of krishna paksha is amavasya. vara is 0=Monday..6=Sunday, matching
date.weekday(), because that is what the code has and a second convention is a second bug.

griha-pravesh.note_en: Traditionally a fixed or gentle nakshatra, outside the rikta tithis.

vehicle.note_en: The moving nakshatras are the traditional choice for anything that travels.

business.en: Starting a business or new work
business.note_en: Pushya is the one most often named for trade.

naming.note_en: Usually the twelfth day; this finds the days around it that also carry a gentle nakshatra.

travel.note_en: The classical disha-shool rules are about direction and are deliberately not applied here.

refused._about: Asked for and refused, with the reason shown to the reader rather than a blank. The Devanagari entries are STEMS, not whole words: Marathi and Hindi inflect, so शस्त्रक्रियेसाठी does not contain शस्त्रक्रिया and a whole-word list quietly matched nothing.
